hypotheses.justification: Split into 0 ≤ r and r < 0. In the first case, use the existing proof, including r = 0. In the second case, Metric.closedBall_eq_empty.mpr makes the ball empty; choose lambda = 0. By its definition, CoordinateSemiconvexOn is vacuous on the empty set because it requires x ∈ C. This also works when n = 0.
